name: Argus
tagline: A terminal tool for quant researchers that tracks signal experiments and anchors their artifacts on-chain.
problem: Quant researchers juggle tools to track signal quality across changing datasets and models.
solution: Logs information-coefficient metrics across runs with a terminal UI and records experiment artifacts on Solana for an auditable history.
demo_moment: Team-described: run an experiment and browse the log history.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Use of Solana” among 169 submissions.
Came from a sponsor's own panel describing the pain.

lessons: Listen to sponsor talks at the event for problems they actually have.
